business_summary: Kunshan Asia Aroma Corp., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of spices and food additives in China. It offers natural ingredients, which includes Acetaldehyde NAT, Octanal NAT, Nonanal NAT, 2-Methylbutyric Acid NAT, Ethyl 2-Methylbutyrate NAT, Vanillin Ex Eugenol NAT, Vanillin Ex Ferulic Acid NAT, Leaf alcohol NAT, Cis-3-Hexenyl Acetate NAT, Cis-3-Hexenyl Butyrate NAT, Citral NAT, a-Ionone NAT, Benzyl Alcohol NAT, Benzaldehyde NAT, Phenylacetic Acid NAT, Phenethyl Alcohol NAT, Methyl Cinnamate NAT, Cocoa Hexenal NAT, Succinic Acid NAT, Diethyl Succinate NAT, Linalool NAT, Raspberry Ketone NAT, Methyl Cyclopentenolone NAT, Maltol NAT, and Melonal NAT. It also provides synthetics ingredients, such as Ligustral, Allyl Amyl Glycolate, Iso Amyl Acetate, Methyl Pamplemousse, Methyl Atratate, Dimetol, Cyclogalbanate, Fraistone, Leaf alcohol, Cis-3-Hexenyl Acetate, and Cis-3-Hexenyl Salicylate; and cooling products, consisting of Menthol Carboxamide and Menthyl Lactate. Its products are used in various industries such as food, tobacco, daily chemicals, pharmaceuticals, animal feed, cosmetics, textiles, and leather. The company also exports its products to the United States, Japan, Europe, and internationally. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Kunshan, China.
business_summary_ko: Kunshan Asia Aroma Corp., Ltd.는 중국에서 향신료 및 식품 첨가물의 연구 개발, 생산 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 제품은 아세트알데히드 NAT, 옥탄알 NAT, 노나날 NAT, 2-메틸부티르산 NAT, 에틸 2-메틸부티레이트 NAT, 바닐린 Ex Eugenol NAT, 바닐린 Ex 페룰산 NAT, 잎 알코올 NAT, Cis-3-헥세닐 아세테이트 NAT, Cis-3-헥세닐부티레이트 NAT, 시트랄 NAT, a-Ionone NAT, 벤질 알코올 NAT, 벤질알코올 NAT, 벤즈알데히드를 포함하는 천연 성분을 제공합니다. NAT, 페닐아세트산 NAT, 페닐알코올 NAT, 메틸 신나메이트 NAT, 코코아 헥세날 NAT, 숙신산 NAT, 디에틸 숙신산염 NAT, 리나룰 NAT, 라즈베리 케톤 NAT, 메틸 시클로펜테놀론 NAT, 말톨 NAT 및 멜로날 NAT. 또한 Ligustral, Allyl Amyl Glycolate, Iso Amyl Acetate, Methyl Pamplemousse, Methyl Atratate, Dimetol, Cyclogalbanate, Fraistone, Leaf 알코올, Cis-3-Hexenyl Acetate 및 Cis-3-Hexenyl Salicylate와 같은 합성 성분도 제공합니다. Menthol Carboxamide와 Menthyl Lactate로 구성된 냉각 제품. 자사의 제품은 식품, 담배, 생활화학제품, 의약품, 동물사료, 화장품, 섬유, 가죽 등 다양한 산업분야에서 사용되고 있습니다. 회사는 또한 제품을 수출하고 있습니다.
